name: prompt-box
title: Prompt Box
description: Enter a prompt and send it
usage: <PromptBox suggestions={["Explain this example"]} onSend={text => localStorage.setItem("last-prompt", text)} />
useCases: On an assistant’s empty screen, an analyst picks “Summarize the report,” refines the prompt and submits it.
In a writing assistant, an author enters a custom request. The app returns its request promise so the form shows progress and allows a retry on failure.
task: Enter a prompt and send it
behavior: Pass suggestions for prompt starters and connect the assistant request through onSend. Return its Promise to reflect submission state.
